title: 次二奈米邏輯製程研究
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解比較基準、架構權衡及證據成熟度，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore comparison baselines, architecture tradeoffs and evidence maturity through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 節點與比較基準
stages.description: 在「節點與比較基準」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for nodes and comparison baselines, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 節點名稱
steps.objective: 完成「節點名稱」的因果圖，把比較基準、架構權衡及證據成熟度中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for interpret node names, connecting relevant limits in comparison baselines, architecture tradeoffs and evidence maturity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：節點名稱。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：節點名稱不是任何單一實體幾何的直接量測。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Interpret node names. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: A node name is not a direct measurement of one physical dimension. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「節點名稱不是任何單一實體幾何的直接量測。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: A node name is not a direct measurement of one physical dimension. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「節點名稱」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for interpret node names and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「節點名稱」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for interpret node names: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 節點名稱的原理
knowledge.text: 節點名稱不是任何單一實體幾何的直接量測。
knowledge.textEn: A node name is not a direct measurement of one physical dimension.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 節點比較需要明確 PPA、工作負載及幾何基準，商業名稱與研究預測不可直接充當性能證據。
knowledge.textEn: Node comparisons require explicit PPA, workload and geometry baselines; commercial names and projections are not performance evidence.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「次二奈米邏輯製程研究」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「節點名稱」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：研究載具的最佳單點不能代表可製造的完整節點。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「奈米元件整合：閘極到背面供電」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：次二奈米邏輯製程研究 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「研究載具的最佳單點不能代表可製造的完整節點」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Sub-2-nm logic process research as the task boundary. After reading “Interpret node names”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: A research vehicle’s best point does not represent a manufacturable node. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Device integration: gate stack to backside power”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Sub-2-nm logic process research: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “A research vehicle’s best point does not represent a manufacturable node” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 評估「節點名稱」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating interpret node names?
options: 節點名稱不是任何單一實體幾何的直接量測。
總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。
頂面膜厚代表所有側壁與底部厚度。
optionsEn: A node name is not a direct measurement of one physical dimension.
Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact.
Top thickness represents all sidewall and bottom thicknesses.
quiz.explanation: 節點名稱不是任何單一實體幾何的直接量測。 節點比較需要明確 PPA、工作負載及幾何基準，商業名稱與研究預測不可直接充當性能證據。
quiz.explanationEn: A node name is not a direct measurement of one physical dimension. Node comparisons require explicit PPA, workload and geometry baselines; commercial names and projections are not performance evidence.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：幾何參數表。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：閘長、閘節距、金屬節距與元件高度各自不同。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Build a geometry table. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Gate length, gate pitch, metal pitch and cell height are distinct. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「閘長、閘節距、金屬節距與元件高度各自不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Gate length, gate pitch, metal pitch and cell height are distinct. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「幾何參數表」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for build a geometry table and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「幾何參數表」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for build a geometry table: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for choose workload baselines, connecting relevant limits in comparison baselines, architecture tradeoffs and evidence maturity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：工作負載基準。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：效能比較需要相同工作負載與限制條件。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Choose workload baselines. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Performance comparisons require matched workloads and constraints. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「效能比較需要相同工作負載與限制條件。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for choose workload baselines: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.title: 功耗效能面積
steps.objective: 完成「功耗效能面積」的故障判別表，把比較基準、架構權衡及證據成熟度中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for separate ppa metrics, connecting relevant limits in comparison baselines, architecture tradeoffs and evidence maturity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：功耗效能面積。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：功耗、效能與面積通常不能同時單獨最佳化。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自行建立三個候選架構的正規化 PPA 表，包含一個低功耗但面積較大方案；標明全部是假設，找出 Pareto 不被支配集合而非加總不相容單位。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate PPA metrics. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Power, performance and area generally cannot be independently optimized together. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Create hypothetical normalized PPA data for three architectures including a low-power, larger-area option. Identify the nondominated Pareto set rather than adding incompatible units.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「功耗、效能與面積通常不能同時單獨最佳化。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate ppa metrics and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「功耗效能面積」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for separate ppa metrics: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Classify evidence types. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Predictions, test demonstrations and production data are distinct evidence. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：不確定度帳本。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：公開缺失參數須標記未知，不能補成廠商規格。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Create an uncertainty ledger. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Missing public parameters remain unknown rather than invented specifications. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「公開缺失參數須標記未知，不能補成廠商規格。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 節點比較需要明確 PPA、工作負載及幾何基準，商業名稱與研究預測不可直接充當性能證據。
